bio: The historic Clos de Chacras winery, built in 1921 by the Gargantini family and restored in 2003, is located 15 minutes from the city of Mendoza and is the ideal place to spend a quiet evening. In the restaurant, where a pleasant terrace or deck next to a pond filled with koi carp complements the charming dining room, you’ll find a fairly casual set menu—unpretentious but sensible, balanced, and carefully presented. Among the items on the menu, we especially liked the flavourful fried empanadas, filled with tender, hand-chopped meat and served with an ingenious smoked chimichurri, though the grilled ribeye steak with beetroot purée is also a great choice. For dessert, try their pear mille-feuille with carob crumble and white chocolate ganache with citrus. Wine pairing is included in the experience!
